issue.title: TestBunProxyLoginWithReservedCharacters is red with Bun 1.3: the request line names port 80
issue.body:
b437e4ad 新加的 TestBunProxyLoginWithReservedCharacters 在我这里是红的：

```
login_test.go:199: bun through the HTTP proxy: <nil> carried http://vendor.example:80/x
```

我 PATH 上的 bun 是 1.3.11，它走 HTTP 代理时 request line 里带了默认端口 `:80`。登录其实是通的，fake 代理只有 Proxy-Authorization 对上才会回 `carried`，只是最后的字符串比较太严。CI 装的是 1.4.2，b437e4ad 的 CI 是绿的。magpie 跑插件用的是自己下的 Bun（BunVersion 1.4.2），用户那边没影响，只是本地 bun 旧一点的人跑全量会多一个红。

比较前把默认端口去掉就行。我在 1.3.11 上试过是绿的，故意把密码改错一个字符还是会红（`proxy login refused`）：

```go
	// Bun 1.3 names the default port in the request line, 1.4 doesn't
	got := strings.Replace(strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), "http://vendor.example:80/", "http://vendor.example/", 1)
	if err != nil || got != "carried http://vendor.example/x" {
```

comments.body:
已修复，分支 [fix/3397-bun-proxy-default-port](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3397-bun-proxy-default-port)，提交 [eaae69f2](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/eaae69f280006590caa1271c9f9f4b01a3ebd8dd)，基于上游 `ed0ab567`。

测试现在只接受相同目标的两种完整结果：`http://vendor.example/x` 和显式默认端口 `http://vendor.example:80/x`；代理认证检查不变，其他主机、路径和端口仍不通过。

用本地代理重放 Bun 1.3 的请求行：原测试失败、修改后通过；实际 Bun 1.4.4 测试通过。临时改错代理密码时仍返回 `proxy login refused`，还原后通过。相关 netproxy race、vet、build 和格式检查通过，我另独立重跑了真实 Bun 测试。

本机没有 Bun 1.3，旧版本结果来自请求行重放，未实际运行旧版；未运行全仓库和跨平台测试。实现和审查使用了 AI 辅助。

issue.title: TestCodexDriftReached and TestCodexBehindReverseProxy go red when two log inserts land in one clock tick

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
#3141 里顺手提过 TestCodexDriftReached 经常红，原因找到了，TestCodexBehindReverseProxy 也是同一个。补丁在这：

https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/commits/fix/drift-tests-tick （基于 b437e4ad，一个 commit，只改测试；`git format-patch --stdout b437e4ad..fix/drift-tests-tick | sha256sum` = `05680184e8dd9e7e2ee49f8785704ddfc5c726b29d0372db247b0ec9296c7f22`）

84210ae7（#1665）之后，codexReached 按 logs_2.sqlite 和 -wal 的大小加修改时间缓存读到的结果，最多 15s。这两个测试是插一行日志、马上问 Drift，连着来三四次。两次插入落在同一个时钟 tick 里，大小和时间都不变，Drift 就拿上一次的结果回答。我在这台 Linux（ext4）上量了：回滚日志模式下连着两次插入，400 次里有 317 次 stamp 没变。

b437e4ad 上 `-count=60`：TestCodexDriftReached 红 11 次（`:280 elsewhere` 5 次，`:284 reached magpie` 6 次），TestCodexBehindReverseProxy 红 2 次（`:293 to chatgpt.com: <nil>`）。每次插入后把库文件的修改时间拨回插入前，等于强制落在同一个 tick，两个都是 20/20 红。

改法：这两个测试测的是 Drift 对每种请求怎么说，什么时候重读日志归 TestCodexReachedReadsLogOnlyWhenItChanged 管，所以每次 log 完把缓存清掉（forgetReached）。同样的注入下 20/20 绿，`-count=200` 0 红，手动把拒绝识别和"去了别处"那条分支弄坏，测试照样会红。

全量（`-count=1`）也跑了，这两个是绿的。剩下的红在 b437e4ad 上本来就红（#3141、#3397，加上我这台机器的环境），提交说明里逐个写了。

app 那边没动。Codex 自己的 logs_2.sqlite 是 WAL，我这台上的 -wal 一直停在 4.4MB（已经回绕过了），之后每次写入只改修改时间（WAL 模式下 400 次里有 156 次不变，都是 -wal 回绕之后）。所以 Codex 在 magpie 上次读的同一个 tick 里写下的请求，比如一次连接加紧跟着的 refused，最多会晚 15s 才在 Drift 里出现，这本来就在 reachedFor 的范围内。如果想让 app 也立刻看到，可以像 filememo、codex_list_tag 那样加一个 settle 窗口，代价是 Codex 每次刚写完的那一小段时间里，每次问都要重读一遍，正好是 #1665 省掉的那些读。要不要加你定。

issue.title: netproxy: System() holds its lock while scutil --proxy runs with no timeout, and a failed read is taken as no proxy

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
查 #3362 时注意到的：`netproxy.System()` 是拿着 sysCache 的锁去调 readSystem 的，macOS 上就是 `scutil --proxy`，走 `proc.Command`，没有超时。设置和环境变量里都没配代理时，每个请求的代理都从 For → System() 来（http.DefaultTransport、gateway 的 upstream transport、MCP、更新检查都用 `netproxy.Func`），所以只要有一次 scutil 不返回，所有要问系统代理的请求都会卡在这把锁上，直到它返回。请求自己的超时也没用：net/http 先看一眼 context 再调 Proxy，调的过程中不会再看。没设系统代理时，有人问就每 2 秒再跑一次。

还有一处：读失败被当成"没有代理"。如果一台机器只能靠系统代理访问厂商，scutil 失败一次，接下来 2 秒的请求就直连了。

这两处分别对应 code standards 里的 "Nothing that can block runs under a lock its reader needs" 和 "A failed read means unknown"。#3362 里没有证据说卡住的就是 scutil，只是那条路径上只有这里会无限等下去。


补丁：https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/commits/fix/system-proxy-read （基于 f3eb9292，一个 commit f3308d19；`git format-patch --stdout f3eb9292..fix/system-proxy-read | sha256sum` = `3381bbdaa1a855b2b6118f6a80d6468b38518d9683224f8249a417de4bcd7485`。之后 main 上没人动过 internal/netproxy，在 a93190ae 上 `git apply --check` 也能直接打上）

- 读挪到锁外，同一时间只跑一个。请求最多等到这次读开始后 2 秒（readWait），之后就用上一次读到的值。第一次读之前什么都没有，所以是直连，和以前第一次读失败时一样。已经超过 2 秒的读，新请求不再等它。
- 读失败就保留上一次的值；失败后的下一次读在后台跑，请求不等。
- scutil 最多跑 10 秒（toolWait），到点结束，这次读算失败。
- Windows 注册表：键或值不存在仍然算没有代理，别的错误算读失败。其他系统本来就不读系统代理，不变。

测试在 Linux 上跑：用一个卡住的假 readSystem 测缓存，用 echo 和 sleep 30 代替 scutil 测超时。每一处我都手动弄坏过，都会红，细节在提交说明里。macOS 和 Windows 上没跑过。ggbdpq 在 #2562 的 testenv 补丁（把 scutil 换成 exit 1 的替身）不受影响：之前什么都没读到时读失败，结果还是没有代理。

issue.title: agent: Claude Code's first write in a fresh magpie takes a #1985 proxy for a relay (a CLI pick writes 127.0.0.1 over it, Disconnect forgets the user's endpoint)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
#1985 的修法是：Claude Code 被手动指到 magpie 前面的代理上（magpie 的 key 不变）时，要等 magpie 在代理那边应答过，才把它当成还在 magpie 上（surelyMagpie）。这个应答来自读操作在后台发起的探测，不会等。可是每次写 Claude Code 的配置之前都会先读一次 routed()，所以在刚启动的 magpie 进程里（我复现出来的都是 CLI），第一次写的时候探测还没回来，代理就被当成了用户自己的中转。surelyMagpie 的注释写的是写操作会等这个应答，但其实没有地方在等；Codex 的 failover 是等的（codexProxyOK）。

我用一个假代理（relay.py，GET / 按 magpie 网关的格式回 `{"name":"magpie"}`），在全新的 HOME 里用 CLI 跑，让代理 0.3s 或 1.5s 才回（走 VPN 的公司代理差不多这个量级）。40b5c2da 和 #3480 的 d970371e 上结果一样：

- `magpie claude fakeco/fake-3`：ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 从代理 `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/corp-relay` 被改回 magpie 自己的 `127.0.0.1:<port>`，用户单独给 haiku 档设的 fake-2 也变成了 fake-3。像 davisjiahao 那种所有请求都必须过合规代理的情况，这就是悄悄绕过了代理
- `magpie provider add …`（它的 sync 会重写 Claude Code 的列表）：magpie 写的 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 被删掉了
- `magpie claude haiku fakeco/fake-3`：报 `pick a model through magpie for Claude Code first; haiku can then have its own`
- `magpie claude default`（Disconnect）：输出 `disconnected from magpie, back to what it had before`，实际上代理地址、magpie 的 key、magpie 写的四档模型（全是 fake-1）都还在，model 是 opus，而 opus 档还指着 magpie 的 fake-1，等于还在经代理走 magpie；用户接 magpie 之前自己的 endpoint 和 key（`https://own.example/api`、`sk-own-user`）已经从 stash 里删掉，找不回来了

代理马上就回的时候，后台探测基本都能先回来，这些都正常，所以在 GUI 里平时看不出来。`magpie web` 启动我也试了（首次启动 0s 和 1.5s，重启 1.5s），都没问题：它的 sync 要等目录和各家的模型列表拉完才跑，那时探测已经回来了。

补丁：https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/commits/fix/1985-writes-ask-first （一个 commit，cd2c6acd，叠在 #3480 的 d970371e 上，因为改的是 #3480 加的 claudeProxied，需要先打那个；`git format-patch --stdout d970371e..fix/1985-writes-ask-first | sha256sum` = `cab0c3b7250d76f8acbc03de844a1233fdad6849909d59eb902f41e456b4cc1c`）。做法是每次写 Claude Code（每个字段的 Set、Sync、Unwire）之前先 claudeAsk：如果是 claudeProxied 会去问的那种地址（proxyBase，不是网关自己的地址，claudeKeyed），并且这个进程里 magpie 还没在那边应答过，就现在问并等结果（magpieAsked，用 probedNow，探测本身 3s 超时）。已经有应答的话不管多旧都照用，和读操作一样。Follow 没动，它在 routed 之前什么都不写，Agents 页下次绘制会再跑。读操作照旧不等（TestReverseProxyTriedFirst）。

修完同样的脚本，0、0.3、1.5s 下这几种都对了，Disconnect 也把 own.example 和 sk-own-user 放回去了，magpie 的东西一点没留。代价是每个进程第一次写要等一个 GET /。之前的读一般已经在后台问过一次，这里不等那一次而是再问一次（和 codexProxyOK 一样），所以代理会多收到一个 GET /；代理不回的话，这次写最多多等 3s。

有一点这个补丁没处理：Apply 和 Disconnect 在写之前的那次读（was、before）看到的还是没问过的状态。实测冷启动 Disconnect（代理 1.5s）以后，重连用的记录（claude.reconnect）里只有 model，少了在 magpie 里给 haiku 设的 fake-2，同样的操作在 magpie 自己的地址上是会记下来的。要修得在 Agent 上加个钩子，让 Apply 和 Disconnect 先问，改动面会大一些，我就先没动。

测试 TestClaudeFirstWriteAsksTheProxy：nginx 和本机两种代理，各测选模型、Sync、设单档、Disconnect。把 claudeAsk 里的等待去掉，8 个子测试全红，每个都红在它要守的那个结果上；只去掉 Unwire 里的那一处，两个 Disconnect 红。全量（树 57ae956b）63 个包通过，红的 7 个包都是这台机器自己的老问题（#3141 那组、Reasonix 用到的 /tmp/.git、graftcp、umask 077、Bun 1.3.11 的 #3397），详细记录在 commit 里。

issue.title: [bug] 模型 id 的区域前缀（WorkBuddy 的 cn:）让能力元数据全部落空：推理档位空、Codex 推理强度回落「中」（catalog 把第一个冒号当尾部 tag 切）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 现状

自定义 provider 指向 WorkBuddy 的代理，模型 id 是 WorkBuddy 原样给的**区域前缀 id**：`cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`cn:glm-5.3-flash`。这两个模型在 models.dev 上都有档位（low、high、max，`deepseek-v4.1-flash` 的 1M 窗口也有），但 magpie 里能力元数据全部为空。

同一台机器上 Codex 的 `models_cache.json`，magpie 交给 Codex 的条目：

| slug | supported_reasoning_levels | default_reasoning_level |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `workbuddy-proxy/cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash` | **[]** | **无** |
| `workbuddy-proxy/cn:glm-5.3-flash` | **[]** | **无** |
| `wong/deepseek-v4.1-flash`（同一模型，id 干净） | low, high, max | high |

后果：Codex 桌面端认为这个模型没有推理档，忽略 config.toml 里的 `model_reasoning_effort = "high"`，界面回落「中」；magpie 的 GUI 里这条模型的窗口也是空的。

## 根因

`internal/catalog/catalog.go` 的 `found()` 把 id 里**第一个冒号**当作 OpenRouter 式的**尾部变体 tag**（`glm-5:free` → 查 `glm-5`）：

```go
if i := strings.IndexByte(b, ':'); i > 0 {
    v, ok := table[b[:i]]
    return v, ok
}
```

但 `cn:` 是模型无关的**区域前缀标记**，模型 id 在冒号**后面**。于是 `cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash` 被切成 `cn` 去查表，什么都查不到。同型的还有三处：`ListedBy` 和 `PricedBy` 的 want 列表只有 `cutAt(b, ':')`（冒号前），`KinEfforts` 的 versionless 形状也带着前缀，全都对不上。

## 修复（fork 分支已备好）

[`catalog-cn-marker-prefix`](https://github.com/NineSu/magpie/tree/catalog-cn-marker-prefix)：`found()` 在冒号前那截查不到任何模型时，把冒号后那截当模型 id 试；`ListedBy` / `PricedBy`（含 canonical 一问）/ `KinEfforts` 同样加上去前缀的候选。`glm-5.3-flash:free` 这类真尾部 tag 行为不变（tag 的 id 冒号前就是模型名，先命中）。

修复后（本机真实 models.dev 缓存验证，prefixed 与 bare 行为一致）：

```
EffortsOf("cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash") = [low high max]  ContextOf=1048576  Thinks=true
EffortsOf("cn:glm-5.3-flash")       = [low high max]  ContextOf=1000000  Thinks=true
PricedBy(alibaba-cn, cn:deepseek-v4.1-flash) = 0.29754/1.19015（与 bare id 一致）
```

## 关联

- #1383：同一类问题（relay 加前缀/后缀改名拿不到能力元数据），`claude-` 前缀和 `[1M]` 后缀两种形状已修，**冒号前缀是还没覆盖的形状**。
- #2888：Trae CN 的 deepseek v4.1 flash 窗口只有 116k（官方 agent 里可选 max 提到 1M）——症状一致，若 Trae CN 的 id 同样带区域前缀，应是同一根因，值得一并用这个视角查。
- #2655：Trae 模型全部没有推理等级（其报告里 WorkBuddy 的正常，若其 WorkBuddy 走插件返回的是干净 id，也和这里对得上）。

## 验证

TDD 红绿：TestContextOf / TestEffortsOf / TestListedBy / TestFamilyLevels / TestPricedByCanonicalID 加了 `cn:` 用例，在旧代码上全部 FAIL，修复后通过。`go test ./...`、`go test -tags nogui ./...`、`go test -race -count=2 ./internal/catalog`、`go vet`（darwin / linux nogui / windows）、`go build`（darwin / linux nogui / windows）、`gofmt -l` 全过。

@yetone 麻烦从这个分支开个 PR，谢谢！

issue.title: [Bug] Codex 内置子代理无法使用非 ChatGPT 账号模型：任务被 ChatGPT 后端封装，子代理启动即被拒（v0.1.1240）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

希望 Codex 的内置子代理能把任务派到 magpie 的非 ChatGPT 账号模型上执行。当前这条路完全不可用。

主代理（lead）在 ChatGPT 账号模型上时，`spawn_agent` 写的任务会被 ChatGPT 后端加密返回。子代理模型设为不含 ChatGPT 账号的路由组时，子代理的第一个请求就被 magpie 拒绝：400 `sealed subagent task`。主代理最后只能弃用内置接口，改用 shell 拉起 `codex exec` 子进程，把任务当 prompt 明文传递。

## Environment

- magpie v0.1.1240
- Codex Desktop 26.1007.71326；Codex CLI 0.162.0-alpha.17.2（`AppData\Local\OpenAI\Codex\bin\`，与 Desktop 同内核）
- Windows 11（内部版本 26300）
- Agents 页 Codex「子代理模型」：`Deepseek-V4.1-Flash` 路由组，effort high；magpie 已写入 `~/.codex/config.toml`
- 主代理模型：gpt-6.1-sol，ChatGPT 账号，经 magpie 接入

## Steps to reproduce

1. magpie Agents 页把 Codex 的「子代理模型」设为 `Deepseek-V4.1-Flash` 路由组（组内只有 DeepSeek，没有 ChatGPT 账号）：

   ![Agents 页子代理模型设置](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qikairo7/magpie/issue-assets/attachments/02-agents-page-subagent-model.png)

   设置项的说明文案也没有提到任何限制：

   ![子代理模型设置的说明](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qikairo7/magpie/issue-assets/attachments/03-agents-page-tooltip.png)

2. Codex 里主代理用 gpt-6.1-sol，spawn 子代理。Agents 页统一设置、spawn 时显式点名 `group/deepseek-v4.1-flash`（带 `fork_turns="none"`）都试过。
3. 子代理启动即失败。

## Actual result

子代理收到的报错：

```text
This subagent's task was sealed by the server that answered its lead (codex), and only that server can open it; group/deepseek-v4.1-flash can't. What is sealed is the task itself: the message the agent that spawned this subagent wrote in spawn_agent, which Codex hands on as the backend sealed it. fork_turns="none" keeps the lead's earlier turns out of the subagent, but not the seal on its task, so it doesn't help here. Give the subagent the lead's model, or a lead model that isn't served by the ChatGPT backend, so its subagents get a task they can read. To go on with this task, use a model on codex for the lead and the subagent, or have the lead spawn the subagent again.
```

报错在子代理界面的样子：

![子代理收到的报错卡片](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qikairo7/magpie/issue-assets/attachments/01-subagent-error-card.png)

magpie usage 里的对应记录：`model=group/deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`agent=codex`、`status=400`、`err="sealed subagent task"`、in/out 均为 0。01:20:51–01:39:58 之间出现 8 次，子代理每次都死在第一个请求上。

会话 rollout 佐证封装来源：每次 `spawn_agent` 的 `message` 参数都是 `gAAAAAB…` 密文。显式指定模型、`fork_turns="none"` 都不改变这一点。

## 主代理后来的绕行（实际代价）

sealed 报错反复出现后，主代理放弃内置接口，在 shell 里跑 `codex exec --help`、读取 magpie 写入 `~/.codex/config.toml` 的模型配置，然后改用子进程派活：

```text
codex exec --ephemeral --sandbox read-only -c approval_policy=never
  --model group/deepseek-v4.1-flash --cd <worktree> --json --output-last-message <file>
```

任务作为 prompt 明文传入。3 个 DeepSeek 子进程会话全部返回 200，任务正常完成。但 `--ephemeral` 子进程不写 rollout、不出现在任何子代理界面，magpie 的 Sessions/Usage 里也没有与主代理的父子关系（#1591 未落地），从外面核对不了。内置多代理被弃用，编排退化成 shell 拉进程——这是主代理自己发现的绕法，不是用户教的。

## Expected

就一件事：内置子代理能把任务派到非 ChatGPT 账号模型上正常执行。

## 已知边界（不重开旧结论）

- #1613：加密的任务只有 ChatGPT 后端能解。
- #1855：不做删 `encrypted` 标记 / 改名 collaboration 命名空间那套（后端 400、封号风险）。

issue.title: Ark Kimi K3.1 Pro: default thinking-off requests fail with temperature 400 (fix branch)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Submitting a tested fix branch for maintainer review, following [the contributor guide](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/main/docs/contributors.md#credit-what-a-reporter-gave). This repository's PR creation policy is `collaborators_only`; creating the upstream PR with this account was refused (`does not have the correct permissions to execute CreatePullRequest`).

- [Fix commit: 8f37ced](https://github.com/dake2482/magpie/commit/8f37ceda35c138ba66d9fd86dc9d41cb69aac2e3)
- [Review the diff against upstream](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/compare/main...dake2482:magpie:codex/fix-ark-kimi-thinking)
- Branch: `dake2482/magpie:codex/fix-ark-kimi-thinking` (6 files, +179/-5)

中文摘要：火山 K3.1 Pro 的服务商测试成功，但 ZCode 经分组发起对话时报 `Turn execution failed / reason=unknown / retryable=false`。网关补了 `thinking: disabled`，而该模式即使省略 temperature 也会被火山拒绝。此补丁在最终请求中仅为这一模式补 `temperature: 0.6`，保留用户确认有效的 `!temperature: 1` + `!thinking: enabled` 覆盖配置。下面列出复现、根因、改进思路及完整验证边界。

## Problem and observed symptoms

A ZCode turn routed through `group/kimi-k3` to Volcengine Ark **`kimi-k3.1-pro`** failed with:

```text
Turn execution failed
provider=magpie model=group/kimi-k3 reason=unknown retryable=false
```

The gateway recorded HTTP 400: `` `temperature` only 0.6 is allowed for this model ``. This was reproduced on macOS with Magpie 0.1.3359, using Ark's Coding Plan. The group name is an alias; the selected upstream model is K3.1 Pro, not K3.

The client's request had `output_config: {"effort":"max"}` and omitted both `thinking` and `temperature`. Minimal shape (conversation/tools omitted):

```json
{
  "model": "group/kimi-k3",
  "max_tokens": 128000,
  "output_config": {"effort": "max"},
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Reply OK."}],
  "stream": true
}
```

## Why provider tests passed while the conversation failed

`forwardRelayed` calls `thinkingOffUnlessAsked` for non-Claude Messages models, adding `thinking: {"type":"disabled"}` when the agent did not provide it. This is intentional for callers such as title requests; `output_config.effort` alone does not enable thinking.

The previous fix in #4495 strips locked Kimi sampling fields and relies on the upstream to choose the appropriate defaults. Real Coding Plan requests checked on 2026-11-10 show a missing case:

| Final thinking mode | Temperature | Observed result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Omitted/default | omitted | 200 |
| Enabled | 1 | 200, thinking and text |
| Disabled | omitted or null | 400, requires 0.6 |
| Disabled | 1 | 400, requires 0.6 |
| Disabled | 0.6 | 200, text |

The provider's tiny probe does not add `thinking: disabled`, so its success did not validate the failing gateway path. Setting `!temperature` to null alone also failed in the real conversation.

The reporter confirmed this extra-body workaround restores their thinking-enabled use:

```json
{
  "!temperature": 1,
  "!thinking": {"type": "enabled"}
}
```

## Change and rationale

Add `arkKimiTemperature` at the final outbound request step, **after** thinking adaptation and `extraBody`. Only for `kimi-k3.1-pro` on `ark.cn-beijing.volces.com`, if the final thinking mode is disabled and temperature is absent/null, supply `0.6`.

This fixes the default request without forcing all callers into thinking mode. Existing explicit thinking choices, numeric extra-body overrides (including the confirmed workaround), other models/providers and token counting retain their behavior. The earlier locked-sampling normalization is unchanged; this supplies the missing mode-dependent default after it. The implementation and scope are documented in [Gateway routing and fallback](https://github.com/dake2482/magpie/blob/8f37ceda35c138ba66d9fd86dc9d41cb69aac2e3/docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md), with wire-level regression coverage in `TestArkKimiThinkingOffTemperature`.

This is a follow-up to #4495, not a replacement for its fix. Other Ark regions and other Kimi model versions are outside the new rule. Agent Plan/pay-as-you-go on the same host are matched by the host/model rule but were not live-tested; the live evidence is for Coding Plan.

## Validation

Checked on macOS/arm64 with Go 1.26.8, in isolated temporary HOME/XDG folders with pinned Go caches, at commit `8f37ceda35c138ba66d9fd86dc9d41cb69aac2e3`, based on upstream `b596da7`.

- `TestArkKimiThinkingOffTemperature`: 20 request-path cases pass. Removing the final `arkKimiTemperature` call makes 10 cases fail with the captured upstream 400, including the original ZCode/group shape; restoring it passes.
- Focused sampling, extra-body and thinking regressions pass. The new regression also passes `-race -count=3`.
- `gofmt -l` and `git diff --check`: no output. Native macOS `go vet ./...` and build, Linux/amd64 vet/build (`-tags nogui`, CGO disabled), and Windows/amd64 vet/build (CGO disabled): pass.
- **Full `go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...` was run and was NOT fully green.** `internal/gateway` passes (940.509 seconds); four other packages have six failing tests, detailed below. All six also reproduce in a separate, unmodified `b596da7` worktree.
- A built sandbox gateway against the real Ark Coding Plan completes all five checks with HTTP 200 and text `OK`: the original Messages/group request without overrides, explicit thinking enabled, Chat thinking disabled, Responses thinking disabled, and the reporter's exact extra-body workaround. Both enabled-thinking cases return thinking content; the three disabled cases return text without it. Temporary credential copies and gateway processes were removed.

### Full-suite failures and controlled follow-up

| Tests | Evidence and follow-up |
| --- | --- |
| `TestGatewayFixQuitsAReplacedMagpieReal`, `TestProxyCheckSaysAProxyPassedBy` | Helper probe timed out / proxy probe returned 502. Both fail on the clean base and pass with the system proxy isolated by a temporary `scutil` stand-in. #2562 explains how the host's macOS proxy escapes a temporary HOME; its comments and ggbdpq's posted isolation patch were read. #5749 also records the helper timeout. The helper additionally passes an instrumented isolated base rerun; its intermittent startup cause is not pinned down. No system proxy setting was changed. |
| `TestBunProxyLoginWithReservedCharacters`, `TestGitUpdateInstallsTheBranchsCommitNow`, `TestGitUpdateKeepsACommitPin` | Fail with PATH's Bun 1.3.9 (explicit default port / git+file commit resolution), pass using Magpie's existing Bun 1.4.4 in the test-only PATH. See #3397 and its posted patch by skygunner, and #5419. |
| `TestCodexOffKeepsAppsOwnConfig/imported` | Expects the original TOML section and quote spelling after import. Actual output retains the env map as an inline table; parsing the before/after `mcp_servers.node_repl` values with `tomllib` shows equality. The same failure is reported in #5749 and #5822 and reproduces on the clean base. This textual preservation assertion remains red; no library change is bundled here. |

The five rerun cases pass together in the controlled rerun. This is not claimed as a full-suite pass. An earlier full invocation with `MAGPIE_NO_ACCOUNTS=1` incorrectly suppressed fixture accounts; that harness flag was removed before the full run reported above.

Not run: the full race suite, browser/UI tests (no GUI assets changed), native Linux/Windows runtime checks, or real non-Coding-Plan Ark endpoints.

AI-assisted implementation and testing. No credentials, conversation history or personal request identifiers are included.

issue.title: TestGitUpdateInstallsTheBranchsCommitNow and TestGitUpdateKeepsACommitPin run on a Bun older than MinBun: red with Bun 1.3.11

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Both tests fail on macOS 27.2 with Homebrew's Bun 1.3.11 on PATH, at 68cb92e8e and at 6c3f113ce, and on a branch on top of them, each in its first `bun add`:

```
=== RUN   TestGitUpdateInstallsTheBranchsCommitNow
    plugin_gitupdate_test.go:69: bun add git+file://$TMP/TestGitUpdateInstallsTheBranchsCommitNow802459769/002/repo.git: exit status 1: bun add v1.3.11 (af24e281)
        Resolving dependencies
        error: no commit matching "" found for "git+file://$TMP/TestGitUpdateInstallsTheBranchsCommitNow802459769/002/repo.git" (but repository exists)
--- FAIL: TestGitUpdateInstallsTheBranchsCommitNow (0.21s)
=== RUN   TestGitUpdateKeepsACommitPin
    plugin_gitupdate_test.go:135: bun add git+file://$TMP/TestGitUpdateKeepsACommitPin586185214/002/repo.git#f785a0085aaff1563b52bf9385348866afee5429: exit status 1: bun add v1.3.11 (af24e281)
        Resolving dependencies
        error: no commit matching "f785a0085aaff1563b52bf9385348866afee5429" found for "git+file://$TMP/TestGitUpdateKeepsACommitPin586185214/002/repo.git#f785a0085aaff1563b52bf9385348866afee5429" (but repository exists)
--- FAIL: TestGitUpdateKeepsACommitPin (0.19s)
```

`realBunSandbox` (internal/plugin/plugin_gitupdate_test.go:26) takes the bun on PATH with `exec.LookPath`, whatever its version. `testenv.Bun` (internal/testenv/bun.go) skips a test when that bun is older than `MinBun` (1.4.2, `BunVersion`, which CI installs), because magpie never runs plugins on one. Taking the bun from `testenv.Bun(t)` in `realBunSandbox` instead, both tests skip here with its message:

```
    plugin_gitupdate_test.go:61: bun 1.3.11 on PATH (/opt/homebrew/bin/bun) is older than 1.4.2, the oldest magpie runs plugins on; install 1.4.2 or newer to run this test
--- SKIP: TestGitUpdateInstallsTheBranchsCommitNow (0.05s)
```

TestBunProxyLoginWithReservedCharacters (internal/netproxy) also takes the bun on PATH directly, and is red with the same Bun (#3397).

Not tried: Bun 1.4.x on this Mac, Linux, Windows. Found while running `go test -tags nogui ./...` for #5987.

issue.title: magpie in a LazyCat app (懒猫微服) asks the box's signed-in administrator for a key, and passes the box's X-HC-* headers on to vendors

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Branch: [Rmosser/magpie `lazycat-sign-in`](https://github.com/Rmosser/magpie/tree/lazycat-sign-in), two commits on origin/main 6c3f113ce, each with its own body: what was run, broken by hand, not tried. It's an issue because PRs here are open to collaborators only.

```
git fetch https://github.com/Rmosser/magpie lazycat-sign-in && git cherry-pick 6c3f113ce..FETCH_HEAD
```

## What's wrong

On a LazyCat box (懒猫微服) magpie runs as an app behind the box's own sign-in. The box's ingress, lzc-ingress, sends a browser that isn't signed in to the box's login page, and puts on each request it passes the app the box account (`X-HC-User-ID`), its role (`X-HC-User-Role`, `ADMIN` or `NORMAL`) and what sent it (`X-HC-Source`, `client` for a browser), in place of what the caller sent. magpie reads none of it, which costs two things:

1. The box's administrator opens magpie from the box's app list, signed in already, and is asked for a key that is in the container's log. A package can only hand the key to every browser that reaches the app, or put a proxy in front that adds the key's cookie to what the box signed in.
2. For a caller signed in to the box, the ingress puts those headers, and the device's, on the app's public paths too, where a package serves the gateway's client routes. The native route, the Codex passthrough and relay, and `/mcp/<server>` passed them on, so a vendor, the ChatGPT backend or a remote MCP server was told the box account's name and role and the device's ids.

## The branch

1. `gateway: a LazyCat box's X-HC-* headers go on only to a provider whose PassHeaders names them`. `proxyIdentity` takes `X-Hc-*` as it takes `Tailscale-*`. A provider's PassHeaders still passes on the names it lists, as 7d196b679 left it.
2. `web: a LazyCat box's administrators open the page with the box's sign-in (MAGPIE_WEB_SIGN_IN=lazycat)`. Opt-in. With it, `webGuard` also lets in an `ADMIN` account sent by a browser, each of the three headers named once, with no key and no cookie of the page's own, so signing out of the box signs out of the page. The box's sign-in is a cookie of the box's, and the box's apps are one site, so it is taken only for what the page itself or the user asked for (Fetch Metadata), never for another page's script, frame, fetch or form, nor from a browser that sends no Fetch Metadata: an earlier build let another app's page on the box include `/boot.js` and read `window.bootPrefs`. Anyone else is told the box's reason. The key's link and cookie work as before, `/api` still answers the page alone, and the client routes on the page's port go to the gateway first, which asks for a gateway key. `StartWeb` refuses another value, and `lazycat` where `LAZYCAT_APP_DOMAIN` isn't set. `docs/reference.md` gets a LazyCat section with a manifest, and `TestLazyCatManifestListsTheClientRoutes` keeps its `public_path` equal to `clientPrefixes`.

Look for harm: nothing in `.github/`, a release script, the Dockerfile, `site/`, `go.mod` or `go.sum`; no address the code connects to (the docs link lazycat.cloud, and the manifest's backend is the app's own container); no credential or config read or written that wasn't; the gateway commit sends less upstream than before.

## What the box does

Read off a probe app on a box (lzcos 1.6.2+fix.4) that echoes its request headers, `/` behind the box's sign-in, `/pub/` public, a TCP ingress beside:

| request | what reached the app | forged `X-HC-*` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| not signed in, `/` | nothing: 307 to the box's login page | |
| not signed in, a public path | no account, role or source | `User-ID`, `User-Role`, `Source`, `Device-ID`, `User-Ticket` taken off (repeated or in lower case too); `User-Groups`, `Original-Host` passed on |
| a browser signed in, `/` or a public path | the account, `ADMIN`, `client`, the device's ids, the sign-in's time | `User-ID`, `User-Role`, `Source`, `Device-Version` replaced by the real ones; `User-Groups`, `Original-Host` passed on |
| another app's container, the app's domain | `/`: 307; a public path: no account | taken off |
| TCP ingress | none of it | every one passed on as sent |

So the sign-in reads `User-ID`, `User-Role` and `Source` alone, never `User-Groups`, and the docs say to let nothing but the box's ingress reach the page's port: not a TCP ingress, nor the box's port forwarding. A `public_path` entry opens its path and what is under it, slash or not (`/exact` opens `/exact/child`, not `/exactly`), as `ClientPath` judges a client route, so the manifest lists `clientPrefixes` as they are.

## Tried on a box

A test app made from the docs' manifest, running a build of this code on 68cb92e8e in the image's place, as the image's user: the box's administrator opens the console with no key, and no cookie is set; `/v1/models` still asks for a gateway key; from another app's page a navigation opens the console, while a script include of `/boot.js` and a frame are turned away; in the container, past the ingress, a request with no Fetch Metadata, no `X-HC-Source`, `NORMAL` or a header twice gets a 401. What wasn't tried is at the end of each commit's body.

Reds met on the way, none from this change: #3397 (open already), #5988, #5989, #5990; and at 6c3f113ce, TestEveryRouteHasACommandOrIsNamed: `POST /api/settings/join`, new with e053c337a, has no command.
